guideposts.label: 3 attackers: Van Aert, Vader, Leknessund
guideposts.detail: Wout van Aert (Visma-Lease a Bike) accelerated as soon as the flag dropped. Milan Vader (Bahrain Victorious) and Andreas Leknessund (Uno-X Mobility) are with them. The peloton trail by 27'' at km 3.

guideposts.label: The gap significantly increases
guideposts.detail: The lead trio are already at km 9. The four chasers trail by 1'. New counter-attackers set off from the b unch, already two minutes behind the leaders.

guideposts.label: The chasers are caught by the bunch at km 16
guideposts.detail: Wout van Aert (Visma-Lease a Bike), Milan Vader (Bahrain Victorious) and Andreas Leknessund (Uno-X Mobility) are 1'20'' ahead.

guideposts.label: 2 leaders: Van Aert and Leknessund
guideposts.detail: Vader is dropped from the breakaway at km 19.

guideposts.label: Herrada on the move on "home roads"?
guideposts.detail: Many Spanish riders (as well as Colombia’s Sergio Higuita) are used to training in the area, part of the Sierra de Gudar, next to the Sierra de Javalambre. It’s the case of Jesus Herrada (Burgos Burpellet BH), who is set to retire at the end of La Vuelta 26. Today’s course echoes the first of his three La Vuelta victories, in 2019: the stage started in Mora de Rubielos (km 122 on today’s course) a
